description: This file defines a class `XAIModelInfo` that extends `BaseLLMModelInfo`. It provides methods for retrieving provider-specific information, validating environment variables and headers, obtaining API URLs and keys, and fetching model names from an external API endpoint related to the 'XAI' provider.

classes.name: XAIModelInfo
classes.description: A class extending `BaseLLMModelInfo` that manages configuration and retrieval of models for the 'XAI' provider, including environment validation and fetching model list from an API.
